title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Eye Twitching
intro: Herbal creams for eye twitching are topical treatments made from natural herbs, plants, and essential oils that help alleviate the symptoms of benign essential blepharospasm, a condition characterized by involuntary twitching or spasms of the eyelid muscles. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat eye twitching include reducing inflammation, relieving stress and anxiety, and promoting relaxation, which can help alleviate the symptoms of this condition. Some examples of herbal creams that can be used to treat eye twitching include Aloe vera cream, which soothes and calms the skin, Chamomile cream, which has anti-inflammatory properties, and Calendula cream, which promotes healing and reduces redness. Other examples include Peppermint cream, which cools and refreshes the skin, Lavender cream, which promotes relaxation and reduces stress, and Green tea cream, which has antioxidant properties and helps to reduce inflammation.
